reviewRubric.questions: Anticipation, blade/body contact, weight, foot sliding, recovery and transition continuity
Can a clean pre-contact clip identify attack direction, charge, threat and available defensive answers?
Distinct hit, miss, block, parry and stagger; hit-stop and shake sell force without concealing the next decision
Horizon stability, roll disorientation/reacquisition, clipping, body overlap, weapon visibility and boundary awareness
Blood origin/scale/duration, sparks, trails, repetition, clutter, contrast and gritty style
Reach vs visible contact, whiff feedback, footwork, evade destination and re-entry
Start/contact/recovery timing, meaningful punish opportunities, interruption and readable pressure escape
Stamina/posture costs, guard-break explanation, recovery opportunity and useful choices across synthetic profiles
Accepted action latency, held/released controls and capture continuity; real input-to-photon/touch comfort remains untested
Unassessed in silent capture: sound layering, cue recognition, reduced-shake/motion comfort and physical device usability
